messages.author: 4e8ae08f32c9149c
messages.subject: problem in labelling bootstrap values
parts:
Dear Developer,

Your package 'ggtree' is useful, but I still got some problem with it. Comparing the visualization result using your package and figtree, I found differences in the bootstrap labelling (an important node was marked with a red arrow in the attached file). Furthermore, the phenomenon was only observed in part of the nodes. Our tree was rerooted with the same branch in both the two tools

So far we cannot tell which one should be reliable, but here we still ask for your explanation about the unusual problem.

Best,
Tzu-Hao Kuo
Biodiversity Research Center, Academia Sinica
